Original steps taken to generate the PDFs:

1) Install  PDF Creator or a similar free PDF printer

2) Copied the HTML into a MS Word document, reformat so that things end on pages appropriately, and rulings/card texts are not split across pages.

3) Print to PDF.

I can provide the original MS Word documents, but updating them would be just as much work as creating them from scratch with the new files.
